one_line: A doctor cannot open a paid-for follow-up because the unlock control stays disabled - the same defect ORC-101 already describes.
not_verified: Whether the mobile app shows the same defect: this reporter did not try it and ORC-101 explicitly excludes it, so it is untested on both tickets.
notes: Same defect as ORC-101, described from the clinic's side rather than the developer's: greyed-out control on the examination tab, tooltip about a pending authorisation, patient has already paid. Worth carrying one detail across before closing - this one came from a customer-facing call, which ORC-101 does not record.
